versions.content: On reception of the UDS Service WriteDataByIdentifier (0x2E), the Dcm module shall check if the DID can be written in the current session (see con- figuration parameter DcmDspDidWriteSessionRef ). If not, the Dcm module shall send a NRC 0x31 (Request Out of Range).
